record.original_question: Let (X, omega) be a compact n-dimensional Kahler manifold, let S be a smooth totally real submanifold of maximal real dimension n, let mu_S be its normalized Hausdorff measure, and let phi_S in E(X, omega) be the unique normalized omega-plurisubharmonic potential with (omega + dd^c phi_S)^n = mu_S. Determine the optimal regularity of phi_S.

evidence.quote: Let mu_S denote the normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on a smooth totally real manifold S subset X of maximal real dimension n. It has been shown by Sadullaev in [Sad76] that S is non pluripolar, hence mu_S is the Monge-Ampere measure mu_S = (omega + dd^c phi_S)^n of a unique function phi_S in E(X, omega) normalized by sup_X phi_S = 0. Question 20 (Berman). What is the optimal regularity of phi_S ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact connected Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$. A smooth submanifold $S\subset X$ of real dimension $n$ is called totally real of maximal dimension if for every $p\in S$ the real tangent space $T_pS$ satisfies $T_pS\cap J(T_pS)=\{0\}$, where $J$ is the complex structure on $TX$. Let $\mu_S$ denote the normalized $n$-dimensional Hausdorff measure carried by $S$ (so $\mu_S$ is a probability measure on $X$). 

By a theorem of Sadullaev, $S$ is non-pluripolar, hence by the variational/pluripotential theory of Berman–Boucksom–Guedj–Zeriahi there exists a unique $\omega$-plurisubharmonic function $\varphi_S$ in the finite-energy class $\mathcal{E}(X,\omega)$ with
$$(\omega+dd^c\varphi_S)^n=\mu_S,\qquad \sup_X\varphi_S=0.$$

Determine the optimal regularity of $\varphi_S$. More precisely, identify the largest function space (e.g. a Hölder class $C^{0,\alpha}$, a Sobolev/Besov class, or finer modulus-of-continuity class) to which $\varphi_S$ always belongs, and exhibit examples showing this regularity cannot be improved.
artifact.status_search_result: Duc-Viet Vu (Math. Ann. 372 (2018), 321–367; arXiv:1608.02794) proved that if $\mu$ is supported on a $C^3$ totally real submanifold of maximal dimension and has an $L^p$ density ($p>1$) with respect to the Hausdorff measure, then the solution of $(\omega+dd^c\varphi)^n=\mu$ is Hölder continuous. This applies to $\mu_S$ and so establishes Hölder regularity of $\varphi_S$. However, the optimal Hölder exponent (and whether better-than-Hölder regularity holds) does not appear to have been pinned down, so the sharp/optimal regularity question remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Complex Monge–Ampère equation for measures supported on real submanifolds
status_evidence.snippet: If K is an immersed C^3 real submanifold whose tangent space at any point is not contained in any complex hyperplane, and μ is a probability measure with L^p density (p>1) compactly supported on K, then (dd^c φ+ω)^n = μ has a Hölder continuous solution.
status_evidence.claim: Hölder continuity of the potential is established, providing a partial answer to the optimal-regularity question.

status_evidence.title: Complex Monge–Ampère equation for measures supported on real submanifolds — Math. Ann.
status_evidence.snippet: Published in Math. Ann. 372 (2018), 321–367, by Duc-Viet Vu.
status_evidence.claim: Peer-reviewed publication establishing Hölder regularity in this setting.
